statements.t: “With the addition of their team and expertise, Maximus expects to expand our ability to deliver innovative solutions to some of the most complex and mission-critical needs of the Departments of War, Homeland Security, and other national security agencies.
Together, we plan to deliver secure, purpose-built solutions that address today’s priorities and tomorrow’s challenges for the men and women in uniform serving our nation.”

“By combining our distinctive expertise in data analytics, AI, and cybersecurity with Maximus’ extensive reach and operational strength, we will accelerate our ability to deliver innovative and highly sought- after solutions .
We look forward to joining forces and continue bringing our best to the mission.”

risks.t: disruption to the parties’ businesses as a result of the announcement and pendency of the proposed acquisition
the diversion of the Maximus management teams’ attention and time from ongoing business operations and opportunities on acquisition-related matters
